wording_status: New wording drafted against the existing Standard Zhuang catalogue and exact English; editorial review pending. No Android XML changes.
notes: Drawing, cursor, assembly and crop. Check temporary attachment versus image deletion, and confirm consistency of terms for panning, retouching, the pixel grid, and freehand smoothing.

entries.source: Drag a line, then drag twice to set its two bends. Finish curve commits it early.
entries.wording: Rag daeuj veh sienq ndeu, caiq rag song baez daeuj dingh song giz goz de. Yungh “Veh liux sienq goz” ndaej guh liux gonq.

entries.source: Drag a selection. Drag inside to move, square corner or edge handles to resize, or the round handle to rotate. Lock proportions keeps its shape.
entries.wording: Rag daeuj senj benq dieg. Rag ndawde daeuj gyaij coh; rag diemj seiq ciggak youq gok roxnaeuz henz daeuj gaij cikconq, roxnaeuz rag diemj ranz daeuj cienj. Yungh “Hawj beijlaeh gvangq / sang mbouj bienq” daeuj hawj yienghde mbouj bienq.

entries.source: Drag across the ellipse's bounding box.
entries.wording: Rag daj gok ndeu daengz gok doiqmienh, ciuq aen seiq ciggak vongz aen bomj.

entries.source: Drag between opposite corners to draw a five-pointed star. Choose an outline or fill.
entries.wording: Rag daj gok ndeu daengz gok doiqmienh daeuj veh aen sing haj gok. Senj veh henz roxnaeuz coq saek rim ndaw.

entries.source: Drag from the start to the end of the line.
entries.wording: Rag daj giz haidaeuz sienq daengz giz sienq sat.

entries.source: Drag from the tail towards the arrowhead. Choose an outline or fill.
entries.wording: Rag daj baih duenh naq bae gyaeuj naq. Senj veh henz roxnaeuz coq saek rim ndaw.

entries.source: Drag out to expand, in to trim. Drag inside to move the bounds. Pinch or Fit for more space. BG fills new space.
entries.wording: Rag ok bae daeuj cuengqhung, rag haeuj daeuj daet henz. Rag ndawde daeuj gyaij coh gij henz. Yungh song gij fwngz gaij gyaengq yawj roxnaeuz yungh “Yawj daengx” hawj miz dieg lai di. Gij dieg moq yungh saek BG.

entries.source: Drag to pan without drawing. Pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Two-finger navigation also works with drawing tools.
entries.wording: Rag daeuj gyaij coh gyaengq yawj, mbouj veh. Yungh song gij fwngz daeuj cuengqhung, sukiq caeuq gyaij coh gyaengq yawj. Seiz yungh gipsaeh veh, lij yungh song gij fwngz gyaij coh ndaej.

entries.source: Draw a crisp line. Adjust Width from 1 to 100 pixels.
entries.wording: Veh sienq ndeu miz henz cingcuj. Gaij gij gvangq daj 1 daengz 100 diemj saek dozsiengq (pixel).

entries.source: Draw around an area. Drag inside to move, square corner or edge handles to resize, or the round handle to rotate. Commit selection applies the edit.
entries.wording: Veh henz aen dieg daeuj senj. Rag ndawde daeuj gyaij coh, rag diemj seiq ciggak youq gok roxnaeuz henz daeuj gaij cikconq, roxnaeuz rag diemj ranz daeuj cienj. Yungh “Guh liux gij senj” daeuj yungh gij gaij.

entries.source: Draw soft watercolor strokes. Strength controls how strongly the colour blends into the canvas.
entries.wording: Yungh mauzbit veh henz myox daeuj veh sienq ngonq. Gaij “Rengz” daeuj dingh saek doxhwnj caeuq benq dieg veh lai noix.

entries.source: Pinch to zoom. Drag to pan.
entries.wording: Yungh song gij fwngz daeuj cuengqhung roxnaeuz sukiq. Rag daeuj gyaij coh gyaengq yawj.

entries.source: Set Radius (px), then drag between opposite corners. The radius is limited to half the shorter side of each rectangle.
entries.wording: Dingh “Gij gyae daj gyang daengz henz (px)”, caiq rag daj gok ndeu daengz gok doiqmienh. Gij gyae neix mbouj ndaej gvaq buenq gij henz ceiq duenj.

entries.source: Smooth freehand strokes
entries.wording: Guh hawj gij sienq yungh fwngz veh juj

entries.source: Smooth pixel edges (anti-aliasing)
entries.wording: Guh hawj henz diemj saek dozsiengq juj (anti-aliasing)

entries.source: Tap an enclosed area. Adjust tolerance for similar colours.
entries.wording: Diemj ndaw aen dieg gij henz vongz rim. Gaij gij caq saek hawj yungh ndaej, daeuj coq gij saek ganq doxdoengz.

entries.source: Pencil keeps crisp edges at any selected width.
entries.wording: Mboujguenj senj gvangq geijlai, Yienzbit hawj gij henz sienq cingcuj.

entries.source: Pencil keeps crisp edges at any selected width.
entries.wording: Mboujguenj senj gvangq geijlai, Yienzbit hawj gij henz sienq cingcuj.

entries.source: Cursor drawing settings…
entries.wording: Seizdin gij veh yungh diemj biumingz giz veh…

entries.source: Enlarges the cursor marker without changing the size of the painted brush stroke.
entries.wording: Cuengqhung diemj biumingz giz veh, mbouj gaij gij cikconq sienq aen mauzbit veh okdaeuj.

entries.source: Drag to move the cursor and start drawing. Tap again to stop drawing.
entries.wording: Rag daeuj gyaij coh diemj biumingz caeuq haidaeuz veh. Caiq diemj daeuj dingzcij veh.

entries.source: Drag to position the cursor. Tap the drawing button to start drawing.
entries.wording: Rag daeuj dingh gij coh diemj biumingz giz veh. Diemj aen nauj veh daeuj haidaeuz veh.

entries.source: Tap the cursor to start or stop drawing.
entries.wording: Diemj diemj biumingz giz veh daeuj haidaeuz roxnaeuz dingzcij veh.

entries.source: Toolbox and tool options. Scroll for more.
entries.wording: Loengx gipsaeh caeuq gij senj yiengh gipsaeh. Gvenj daeuj yawj lai di.

entries.source: Pixel grid appears at 800% zoom or above. Rulers show positions in image pixels.
entries.wording: Cuengqhung daengz 800% roxnaeuz gvaq 800%, gij sienq faen diemj saek dozsiengq (pixel) cij yienhʼok. Cez yienhʼok gij vih ciuq diemj saek ndaw dozsiengq.

entries.source: An image cannot attach to itself or one of its attached images.
entries.wording: Dozsiengq ndeu daeb mbouj ndaej henz bonjfaenh de, roxnaeuz henz dozsiengq ndeu daeb caeuq de lo.

entries.source: Cropped thumbnail: %1$s
entries.wording: Dozsiengq iq yawj sien gij daet henz: %1$s

entries.source: Drop at a highlighted edge: right/top aligned or below/left aligned.
entries.wording: Fongq youq henz yienhʼok cingcuj haenx: fongq baih gvaz couh baih gwnz doiqcaez; fongq baih laj couh baih swix doiqcaez.

entries.source: Image assembly workspace. Drag placed images or drop thumbnails to snap at right or bottom targets. Pinch to zoom; drag empty space to pan.
entries.wording: Giz guh hong doxcomz dozsiengq. Rag dozsiengq fongq le roxnaeuz fongq dozsiengq iq youq henz baih gvaz roxnaeuz baih laj hawj de daeb caez. Yungh song gij fwngz gaij cikconq gyaengq yawj; rag youq dieg hoengq daeuj gyaij coh gyaengq yawj.

entries.source: Image thumbnails and filenames. Scroll horizontally for more.
entries.wording: Dozsiengq iq caeuq coh vwnzgen. Gvenj baih swix roxnaeuz baih gvaz daeuj yawj lai di.

entries.source: Invalid image attachments.
entries.wording: Gij dozsiengq daeb caeuq doxde mbouj habfap.

entries.source: No attachment fits within the current coordinate range. Try smaller image sizes.
entries.wording: Mbouj miz aen dozsiengq daeb ndaej youq ndaw hanh X caeuq Y seizneix. Yungh dozsiengq iq di yawj.

entries.source: Some previews could not be decoded. You can remove those images or try saving the assembly.
entries.wording: Miz geij aen dozsiengq iq doeg mbouj ndaej. Mwngz ndaej duz gij dozsiengq haenx, roxnaeuz swq rom gij dozsiengq doxcomz.

entries.source: Sort tray
entries.wording: Baiz gij dozsiengq iq

entries.source: That arrangement overlaps another image. Use a different edge or unplace the attached images first.
entries.wording: Gij baiz neix dap gvaq lingh aen dozsiengq. Yungh lingh henz ndeu, roxnaeuz sien gaij ok gij dozsiengq daeb youq henz haenx, mbouj duz dozsiengq.

entries.source: The assembly exceeds Android's coordinate range.
entries.wording: Gij dozsiengq doxcomz gvaq hanh X caeuq Y Android hawj yungh.

entries.source: The attachment image is missing.
entries.wording: Gij dozsiengq daeb youq henz haenx cauq lo.

entries.source: The images cannot fit within Android's coordinate range. Choose smaller image sizes.
entries.wording: Gij dozsiengq fongq mbouj ndaej youq ndaw hanh X caeuq Y Android hawj yungh. Senj dozsiengq iq di.

entries.source: The normalized image dimensions are outside Android's range.
entries.wording: Gij cikconq dozsiengq gaij doxdoengz le mbouj youq ndaw hanh Android hawj yungh.

entries.source: Trim from the original edges. Drag the handles or enter amounts below. Source files stay unchanged.
entries.wording: Daj gij henz yienzlaiz daet. Rag gij diemj giuzj roxnaeuz sij gij soq daet henz youq laj. Vwnzgen yienzlaiz mbouj bienq.

entries.source: Unplace
entries.wording: Gaij ok daj gij vih fongq

entries.source: Give all %1$s images the same %2$s. Each image keeps its own aspect ratio. Original files and crop settings stay unchanged.
entries.wording: Hawj %1$s aen dozsiengq gij %2$s doxdoengz. Moix aen dozsiengq baeujcij beijlaeh gvangq / sang bonjfaenh. Vwnzgen yienzlaiz caeuq gij seizdin daet henz mbouj bienq.

entries.source: Common width as a percentage of %1$d px
entries.wording: Gvangq doxdoengz (beijlaeh moix bak faenh %1$d px)

entries.source: Common height as a percentage of %1$d px
entries.wording: Sang doxdoengz (beijlaeh moix bak faenh %1$d px)
